description: Holds client scheme mapping records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to client, scheme details.
business_purpose: Used to track and report client scheme mapping records for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one client scheme mapping.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the client scheme mapping.

columns.name: ClientId
columns.description: Reference to the client linked to this client scheme mapping.

columns.name: SchemeDetailsId
columns.description: Reference to the scheme details linked to this client scheme mapping.

columns.name: created_byId
columns.description: User who created the client scheme mapping.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

columns.name: modified_byId
columns.description: User who last modified the client scheme mapping.

columns.name: modified_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified.

relationships.description: Each client scheme mapping references one client (client).
Each client scheme mapping references one scheme details (scheme details).
